mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS productId, p.title, p.price, p.product_condition AS productCondition, p.trade_type AS tradeType, p.longitude, p.latitude, -- 计算距离（单位：公里），使用更精确的Haversine公式 6371.0 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{centerLatitude})) * COS(RADIANS(p.latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(p.longitude - #{centerLongitude})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{centerLatitude})) * SIN(RADIANS(p.latitude)) ) AS distance FROM product p WITH (INDEX(idx_longitude, idx_latitude)) -- 强制使用经纬度索引 WHERE p.status = #{status} AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL -- 矩形范围预过滤（提高查询性能） AND p.longitude BETWEEN #{minLongitude} AND #{maxLongitude} AND p.latitude BETWEEN #{minLatitude} AND #{maxLatitude} HAVING distance <= #{radius} ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product p WITH (INDEX(idx_longitude, idx_latitude)) -- 强制使用经纬度索引 WHERE p.status = #{status} AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL -- 矩形范围预过滤（提高查询性能） AND p.longitude BETWEEN #{minLongitude} AND #{maxLongitude} AND p.latitude BETWEEN #{minLatitude} AND #{maxLatitude} AND 6371.0 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{centerLatitude})) * COS(RADIANS(p.latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(p.longitude - #{centerLongitude})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{centerLatitude})) * SIN(RADIANS(p.latitude)) ) <= #{radius}
